slurm.scheduler_directives: ##SBATCH --constraint=mla  # uncomment for Navy and AFRL DSRC systems

workload_settings.user_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo "user script on $(hostname); RAY_ADDRESS=${RAY_ADDRESS}"
python - <<'PYEOF'
import ray, socket, time
ray.init(address='auto')
@ray.remote
def where(i):
    time.sleep(0.5)
    return socket.gethostname()
hosts = ray.get([where.remote(i) for i in range(12)])
head = socket.gethostname()
print('cluster CPUs:', ray.cluster_resources().get('CPU'), '| head:', head, '| 12 tasks ran on:', sorted(set(hosts)))
assert hosts and all(h != head for h in hosts), 'tasks ran on the head (it has 0 CPUs) or nowhere'
PYEOF
